description: The sibling sites Canari opens (docs/wiki/backlog.d/sign-in-handoff-to-the-ecosystem-sites-and-migallery-notifications.md, owner 2026-11-07/08), in the launcher's order. `origin` is where each answers today. `miconnect` says it signs in through MiConnect, which is the ONLY condition for being in the handoff registry. `handoff` turns the one-time sign-in handoff ON for that site and may be true only once the site's own redemption (`/auth/handoff`) is LIVE in production: before that, Canari would land a token on a page that answers 404. `dests` is the closed allowlist of paths a handoff may land on (`{uuid}` stands for one lowercase UUID segment). core-service's registry (apps/core-service/src/auth/handoff/handoff-sites.ts) and the frontend's (frontend/src/lib/navigation/ecosystemSites.ts) each assert their copy equals this file.
